# SCI-CAL v0.1 Engineering Conformance r0.4 Change Log

Date: `2026-08-20`

Engineering revision r0.4 is the normative companion to Science-Team
Rationale r0.5. It carries the approved Q01--Q09 meanings into logical records,
evaluation order, evidence requirements, dispositions, and all shared formal
clauses.

Key repairs are the exact `xs` type and Tune conditions; CAL-before-PTC order;
SCI-BEAM source-factor record; closest accepted APT and optional TolProj child
rescale; exact photometric/passband and atmosphere records; whole-observation
quality classification; supported engineering calibration; downstream noise
boundary; explicit unavailable systematic products; and concrete closure and
transfer evidence records.

The revision preserves all stable IDs: 11 assumptions, 50 requirements, 30
edge predictions, and nine owner-decision identifiers. It does not prescribe
software structure or assert implementation conformity.
